title: fix(nodes): reject blank camera snap --facing
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Blank `nodes camera snap --facing` values silently triggered a facing-less capture.

## User Impact

| Input | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Empty or whitespace | Validation error |
| `front`, `back`, `both` | Corresponding capture requests |
| ` FRONT ` | Normalized front capture |
| Omitted | Existing facing-less capture, including device selection |

## Why This Change Was Made

Preserve explicit blanks through validation so they fail before node lookup or Gateway contact.

## Evidence

- Linux CLI actions: blank regressions fail on main; repaired and adjacent tests pass.
- Execution: baseline 6.52 s, repaired suites 5.48 s wall. Dependency setup: 38.96 s separately.
- Gateway calls captured; live camera hardware untested. Full native preparation gates unrun; GitHub merge checks remain required.
